faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the APS Bengdubi Headmaster/Headmistress recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the school before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Headmaster/Headmistress post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Graduation with a minimum of 50% marks, along with a B.Ed/M.Ed/B.El.Ed or a Two-year Diploma in elementary education.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any teaching experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 08 years of teaching experience is required, with at least 05 years as a Primary Teacher (PRT) in a CBSE recognized school.

faq.question: Q4. What are the age limit criteria for the Headmaster/Headmistress position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 55 years. However, age relaxation is provided for Ex-Servicemen (ESM) and teachers from the same school, up to 57 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the Headmaster/Headmistress post?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 250/- for all categories, including General, OBC, SC, and ST.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Headmaster/Headmistress position at APS Bengdubi?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it, and send it along with required documents via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Panel Interview. Candidates shortlisted based on their applications will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is CTET/State TET qualification mandatory for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must be qualified in CTET/State TET and OST to be eligible for the Headmaster/Headmistress position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Headmaster/Headmistress post is on a Contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Army Public School Bengdubi, which is apsbengdubi.org.
